context_requirements: Dependence on EGFR/ERBB2-driven signalling for proliferation or survival
Expression of EGFR or ERBB2 (or ERBB3) and intact downstream MAPK/PI3K signalling
For strong antiproliferative response, intact RB and TP53 pathways
Lack of bypass receptor tyrosine kinase activation (e.g. MET, FGFR, IGF1R) that can rescue signalling
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated genes (e.g. CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, TOP2A) at 24 h in any line
No induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, EGR1, JUN, DUSP6) at 6 h in any line
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines, including lines without EGFR/ERBB2 expression
No difference between EGFR/ERBB2-high and EGFR/ERBB2-low lines
Predominant interferon or unfolded protein response without proliferation changes
